term: International Journal of Data Warehousing and Mining
definition: The International Journal of Data Warehousing and Mining (IJDWM) is a quarterly peer-reviewed academic journal covering data warehousing and data mining.
details: It was established in 2005 and is published by IGI Global. The editor-in-chief is David Taniar (Monash University, Australia).
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. That care with the raw material is International Journal of Data Warehousing and Mining.
